description: Cover: the Leonida Trophy Atlas hero with 13 of 55 trophies earned, the Up next panel led by the missable meditation trophy, and the roadmap preview.
Roadmap view: the four-stage route to the platinum, progress per category, and the six time-saving habits to start with.
Guide panel open: the UFO trophy The Truth Is Out There with its full guide and named sources beside the checklist.
Detail view: the missable Positive Mental Attitude trophy with its guide open, missable flag, and sources.
